# Whallm 1.1.9
Changes since v1.1.8. Built from [`ba9e126`](https://github.com/yanun0323/Whallm/commit/ba9e12612fdb26378ec0557c1c7326fa20b3e728).
## Tool calls and prompt caching
- Fix `/v1/responses` tool results that contain an array of `input_text` parts. All models now accept these arrays as well as strings, preserving text order and whitespace. The matching `function_call` and `call_id` are still required. Addresses [#13](https://github.com/yanun0323/Whallm/issues/13). - Reuse DeepSeek V4.1 prompt caches across tool calls, including DSpark target and draft state in memory and disk modes. Keep a request's prompt snapshot alongside its final state instead of immediately evicting it. Includes [#12](https://github.com/yanun0323/Whallm/pull/12). - Fix cache positions after the end-of-response token. Older ordinary disk caches are ignored and rebuilt on demand; model files are unchanged. The first request after updating may need to process the prompt again. - Update the app's memory estimate to include the extra saved states, V4.1 DSpark snapshots, and temporary snapshots. The estimate is not a hard memory limit.
## Qwen runtime and diagnostics
- Reduce redundant attention, routing, N-gram, and MTP work, and batch large expert-cache evictions. - Add opt-in Qwen controls for bounded expert processing, N-gram caching, attention paths, prefill reads, and expert reuse between input processing and generation. Experimental options retain their existing defaults. - Make Throughput wait for pending model-setting changes and include additional runtime diagnostics in exported results. - Add opt-in Qwen and MiMo profiling tools. Profiling results and experimental presets are not release-wide speed guarantees.
## MiMo and attachments — preview
- Add the pinned MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL installed model, native text/image processing, limited PCM WAV input, and bounded PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX input. - Add Chat attachment pickers, drag-and-drop, quota indicators, upload progress, and cancellation. API media support remains model-specific. - Add optional bounded layer-major text prefill for MiMo; its App default remains off. - Include an opt-in MCP client with explicit, single-use tool approvals. Inference APIs do not execute MCP tools automatically; an integrated App Agent and approval UI are not included.
MiMo remains preview support, not completed full-model or end-to-end acceptance. Audio is limited to 24 kHz, 16-bit PCM WAV, up to 30 seconds per clip and two clips per request. Asset uploads are limited to 8 MiB per file; document and combined media limits also apply. Video, audio output, and full Office-format fidelity are not supported. See the [MiMo input limits and validation status](https://github.com/yanun0323/Whallm/blob/v1.1.9/docs/mimo-development.md).
## Validation and upgrade notes
- 645 Python tests passed with `MLX_ENABLE_TF32=0`. - 169 Swift tests passed; four optional installed-model checks were skipped. - The local App and extracted ZIP passed strict signature checks and English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese startup with access to the project build directory and Swift resource bundle denied. - The release workflow repeats these checks on the signed, notarized package and the downloaded GitHub ZIP before publishing the Sparkle update feed.
No new full-model performance benchmark was run for this release. Historical measurements retain their original workloads and limitations. The previously observed Qwen MTP/non-MTP output difference remains unresolved; fixed seeds do not guarantee identical output across acceleration settings.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. Model weights are downloaded separately. This is a distribution build; local-only debug and Dry run features are not included.
[Full changelog](https://github.com/yanun0323/Whallm/compare/v1.1.8...v1.1.9)

## Whallm 1.1.7-dev.2 — Alpha
This alpha adds a Throughput benchmark page and updates model defaults. Select **dev** in **Settings → Updates** to receive it. Stable users continue to receive official releases only.
### Throughput benchmark
- Select an installed model and run the benchmark; the app loads the selected model automatically. - Choose **Code** or **Novel**. Both are bundled and work offline: a Whallm source snapshot and Herman Melville's *Moby-Dick*. Each contains enough tokens for 200K inputs with all three supported tokenizers, without repeating a short excerpt. - Select one or more context lengths from **1K to 200K**, with a generation limit of **128, 1024, or 4096** tokens. - View first-token latency, time per output token, input/output speed, total time, throughput, and peak MLX memory. Results include the slots used by that run. - Copy results as **plain text, JSON, or a Markdown table**. The results table fills the available width, and settings controls align on the right. - Cancel a running benchmark and retain completed results. Tests run one request at a time with prompt reuse disabled; model loading and input tokenization are excluded from timing, and no extra warm-up is performed.
### Model settings
- **Max tokens now defaults to 8192 for every model**. Explicitly saved values remain unchanged; reset or edit Advanced Settings to change an existing preference.
### Validation and alpha limits
- Development checks passed 412 Python tests and 82 Swift tests. Three Swift tests require unavailable model fixtures and were skipped; the interactive Keychain round-trip test was excluded. - Packaging checks verify signatures, notarization, all three localizations, and isolated startup for both the app and an extracted ZIP copy. - **Dry run is available only in local builds.** This alpha excludes the simulated-results option and its generator. - Corpus coverage is an offline tokenizer check, not a measured 200K generation result. No new full-model speed or output-quality claim is made. Actual generation can end before the selected output limit. - DeepSeek V4.1 remains experimental and text-only; its previous unsupported features remain unchanged.
